post_caption:
Digital Arrest Scam 🚨 Ye video call aaye toh paise mat bhejna (Hindi)

Anjaan number se video call: "Main CBI officer hoon. Aapke parcel me drugs mile. Aap digital arrest me ho, kisi ko mat batana. Case band karna hai toh 50 hazaar bhejo." Peeche police station, uniform, sab. 😨

Sach: 'digital arrest' jaisa kuch hota hi nahi. Police video call pe arrest nahi karti, aur paise leke case band nahi karti.

🚩 Red flags:
1️⃣ Video call pe 'police' ya 'CBI'
2️⃣ 'Kisi ko mat batana'
3️⃣ Case band karne ke liye paise

✅ Rule: call kaato, ghar walon ko batao, cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo.
